Gold.note: Central bank buying and rate cut expectations support elevated prices.

Silver.note: Industrial demand from solar offsets recent price weakness.

Copper.note: Smelter treatment charge squeezes and green transition demand underpin prices.

Uranium.note: Structural supply deficit and renewed nuclear build programs drive bullishness.

Lithium.note: Near-term oversupply and slowing EV demand growth weigh on sentiment.

Nickel.note: Continued Indonesian supply growth and weak stainless steel demand pressure prices.

Zinc.note: Smelter feed shortages and mine closures tighten the concentrate market.

Iron Ore.note: Persistent weakness in China's property sector limits upside potential.

Coal.note: Elevated global supply and long-term energy transition cap long-term upside.

Rare Earths.note: Geopolitical supply risks and steady EV motor demand provide a floor.

Manganese.note: Steady steel production but lack of distinct catalysts keeps the outlook slightly bearish.

PGM.note: Hydrogen economy potential and supply constraints in South Africa support prices.

Potash.note: Stable global agricultural demand balances out normalized supply chains.

Aluminum.note: Chinese production caps and growing green energy demand support a bullish bias.

Diversified.note: Broad commodity cycle support and strong balance sheets across major miners.
